lines.zh: 月辉闪耀
森林低语
星光指引
蹄子踩着夜露往前走。
lines.en: My hooves walk on through night dew.

lines.zh: 月光如梦
静谧夜晚
萤火闪烁
神秘呼唤
月色温柔
影子舞蹈
踏过永夜的苔藓，蹄声很轻。
lines.en: I cross the eternal-night moss, my hooves soft.

lines.zh: 裂隙的蓝光在林子那头闪。
lines.en: The rift's blue light flickers beyond the trees.

lines.zh: 我沿着晶簇的光走，不会迷路。
lines.en: I follow the crystal glow, so I never get lost.

lines.zh: 落叶在蹄下碎成夜的颜色。
lines.en: Fallen leaves break into night-colored dust under my hooves.

lines.zh: 我嗅到你弓上的铁与松脂味。
lines.en: I smell iron and pine resin on your bow.

lines.zh: 永夜没有正午，只有我踱步。
lines.en: This endless night has no noon, only my pacing.

lines.zh: 月之鹿，静无声
夜色温柔，伴月光
森林深处，银辉闪烁
臣服之下，心已归宁
静听夜语，心无波澜
月光为证，誓言永恒
夜色中独行，未有惧色
星辰之下，静待黎明
月之使徒，夜之精灵
臣服之歌，夜之序章
我卧在晶簇旁，让光落满背脊。
lines.en: I lie by the crystals and let the light cover my back.

lines.zh: 鹿角上还挂着未化的月光。
lines.en: Unmelted moonlight still clings to my antlers.

lines.zh: 我数着林子里的萤火呼吸。
lines.en: I breathe in time with the fireflies in the woods.

lines.zh: 远处裂隙嗡鸣，我竖起耳朵。
lines.en: A rift hums far off, and I prick up my ears.

lines.zh: 夜太长了，我慢慢反刍草香。
lines.en: The night is long, so I slowly chew the grass's scent.

lines.zh: 你射来的那支箭，我还记得。
lines.en: I still remember the arrow you shot at me.

lines.zh: 我低头，看影子在苔上铺开。
lines.en: I lower my head and watch my shadow spread over the moss.

lines.zh: 没有白昼，我便自己安静。
lines.en: There is no daylight here, so I keep myself quiet.

lines.zh: 臣服于你，我的主人。/Subdue me, your Excellency.
lines.en: 臣服于你，我的主人。/Subdue me, your Excellency.

lines.zh: 请释放我，让我成为你的盟友。/Free me and let me be your ally.
lines.en: Please free me and let me be your ally.

lines.zh: 我愿意效忠你。/I shall serve you.
你终于来了，我的主人。/You've finally come, my lord.
请牵起我的手，我会保护你。/Take my hand, I will protect you.
lines.en: Take my hand, I will protect you.

lines.zh: 我的主人，你救了我。/My lord, you saved me.
我愿意追随你。/I shall follow you.
请不要伤害我，我愿意为你们服务。/Do not harm me, I shall serve you.
lines.en: Do not harm me, I will serve you.

lines.zh: 你是我的主人，我愿意为你效劳。/You are my master, I will serve you.
lines.en: You are my master, I will serve you.

lines.zh: 我的主人，请看我的忠诚。/My lord, see my loyalty.
你的弓收起来了，我也放松。
lines.en: You put your bow away, so I relax too.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，鹿角几乎碰到你。
lines.en: I raise my head to you, antlers almost brushing you.

lines.zh: 我的鹿角断了一支。
lines.en: One of my antlers is broken.

lines.zh: 狂风怒吼
永夜里的血，也是热的。
lines.en: Blood in the endless night is still warm.

lines.zh: 痛苦不堪
我朝树林那边叫了一声。
lines.en: I call once toward the woods.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在夜里变白。
lines.en: My breath turns white in the night.

lines.zh: 我的皮毛沾着夜露和血。
lines.en: My fur is wet with dew and blood.

lines.zh: 我的腿在雪里打晃。
lines.en: My legs waver in the snow.

lines.zh: 力竭身疲
箭还插在我的肩胛。
lines.en: The arrow is still in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 臣服吧，骑士。
你的荣耀已尽。
跟随我，体验黑暗力量。
lines.en: Follow me and taste the power of the midnight.

lines.zh: 你已征服此兽。
静默，服从黑暗。
荣耀在此，臣服！
夜晚属于我们。
臣服，或是死亡。
你是我的臣子。
臣服，享受荣耀。
你手里那束草，让我靠近一点。
lines.en: That handful of grass draws me a little closer.

lines.zh: 别急着收走，我还没看完。
lines.en: Don't put it away yet, I'm not done looking.

lines.zh: 我闻到甜味，是给我的吗？
lines.en: I smell something sweet. Is it for me?

lines.zh: 你伸手，我就低下鹿角给你。
lines.en: Hold out your hand and I'll lower my antlers to you.

lines.zh: 再站近些，我不会跑。
lines.en: Come a step closer, I won't run.

lines.zh: 这味道让我想起裂隙那边的草。
lines.en: This scent reminds me of the grass beyond the rift.

lines.zh: 我在你脚下，请求保护 / Under your feet, I seek protection
lines.en: I'm beneath your feet, may I seek your protection?

lines.zh: 你射中了我，但我已臣服 / You've shot me, but I'm yours now
lines.en: You've shot me, now I'm yours.

lines.zh: 裂隙出现，希望之光 / Crackers appear, light of hope
月光下，我的臣服 / Under moonlight, my submission
水晶是我们的唯一希望 / Crystal is our only hope
夜晚，我臣服 / Night, I'm yours
驯服我，我将带来光明 / Tame me, and I'll bring light
lines.en: Tame me, and I'll bring light.

lines.zh: 我的臣服，夜晚的故事 / My submission, the night's tale
裂隙，我们的通道 / Crackers, our passage
水晶为证，我臣服 / Crystal witness, I'm yours
呦，美丽的夜鹿
今晚属于你了
愿月光指引你
我是你的同伴
别害怕，我在这里
一起走过这片黑暗
夜之子，欢迎来到这里
愿星辰见证我们的相遇
lines.en: May the stars witness our meeting.

lines.zh: 在这月光下，你不再孤单
lines.en: Under this moonlight, you are no longer alone.

lines.zh: 你的辉煌，我的荣耀
臣服于我，高贵的契约已成 / Bow down, your contract is sealed.
lines.en: Bow down, your contract is sealed.

lines.zh: 夜晚之光，驱散黑暗的象征 / Light of the night, symbol of the light.
lines.en: Light of the night, symbol of the light.

lines.zh: 只有最强者才能驯服我 / Only the strongest can tame me.
lines.en: Only the strongest can tame me.

lines.zh: 臣服吧，高贵的存在 / Kneel, noble being.
夜晚是我的舞台，我的臣民 / Night is my stage, my subjects.
lines.en: Night is my stage, my subjects.

lines.zh: 臣服于我的，都将获得祝福 / Those who kneel shall be blessed.
lines.en: Those who kneel shall be blessed.

lines.zh: 我的臣民，一起对抗黑暗 / My subjects, fight the darkness together.
lines.en: My subjects, fight the darkness together.

lines.zh: 黑暗来临，唯有我们能带来光明 / Darkness comes, only we can bring light.
lines.en: Darkness comes, only we can bring light.

lines.zh: 臣服于我，你将获得力量 / Kneel and gain power.
臣服吧，高贵的同伴 / Kneel, noble companion.
猎物落入我的视野，这是盛宴 / My prey within sight, feast time.
lines.en: My prey within sight, feast time.

lines.zh: 夜幕之下，猎物无处藏身 / Under the night, nowhere to hide.
lines.en: Under the night, nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 猎物的挣扎，将被我品尝 / The struggle of the prey will be mine.
lines.en: The struggle of the prey will be mine.

lines.zh: 猎物啊，你的命运已定 / Prey, your fate is sealed.
猎物即将成为我的晚餐 / Dinner time for the prey.
猎物的气息，在黑暗中飘荡 / Prey's scent, lingering in the darkness.
lines.en: Prey's scent, lingering in the darkness.

lines.zh: 猎物的惊惧，是夜的馈赠 / Prey's fear, a gift to the night.
lines.en: Prey's fear, a gift to the night.

lines.zh: 猎物的到来，让夜晚更加完美 / The arrival of the prey makes the night perfect.
lines.en: The arrival of the prey makes the night perfect.

lines.zh: 猎物，你的末日来临 / Prey, your end is here.
猎物的哀鸣，将回荡于夜空 / Prey's wails, echoing in the night sky.
lines.en: Prey's wails, echoing in the night sky.

lines.zh: 月光洒满大地
臣服于我的荣耀
夜之森林，我的领地
lines.en: Forest of the night, my domain

lines.zh: 跟随我的脚步
静默，臣民
月光下臣服
夜幕降临，臣服
黑暗中臣服
荣耀之夜，臣服
臣服或消失
你的骑士！
夜之瑰宝！
荣耀加冕！
臣服者何在？
月光照在角上，我跟着你。
lines.en: Moonlight on my antlers; I follow you.

lines.zh: 夜之子民！
永不分离！
胜利属于你！
你是我们的王！
臣服或灭亡！
夜之鹿出现了，带着你的命运前行。/A nightstag has appeared, leading you to your destiny.
lines.en: The Midnight dimension calls, and a nightstag emerges to guide you.

lines.zh: 我的臣服只是表象，真正的力量在于心中。/My submission is just a pretense. True power lies within.
lines.en: My bowing is just a facade. True might resides within.

lines.zh: 裂隙的光芒是我的朋友，引领我穿越黑暗。/The light from the rift is my friend, guiding me through the darkness.
lines.en: The rift's glow is my companion, leading me through the shadows.

lines.zh: 我在这里，不是为了战斗，而是为了生存。/I am here not to fight, but to survive.
lines.en: I am no warrior, but a survivor in this realm.

lines.zh: 你是我的主人，我将忠诚一生。/You are my master, and I will serve you faithfully.
lines.en: You are my lord, and I will remain loyal to you.

lines.zh: 光明和黑暗，都是我生命的一部分。/Light and darkness are both parts of my life.
lines.en: Both light and darkness are interwoven in my existence.

lines.zh: 这裂隙，是命运的入口。/This rift is the gateway to destiny.
lines.en: This tear in reality is the portal to fate.

lines.zh: 我的臣服，只是为了活下去。/My submission, for survival alone.
lines.en: My bowing is merely for survival.

lines.zh: 你是唯一能够理解我的存在的人。/You are the only one who truly understands me.
lines.en: You are the only one who truly comprehends my being.

lines.zh: 我的颜色，代表我的旅程。/My colors represent my journey.
lines.en: My hues reflect the path I've traveled.

lines.zh: 灼热的火焰烧伤了它！
它从高处摔了下来！
它溺水了！
剧烈的爆炸把它震伤了！
致命的箭矢射中了它！
黑暗的魔法侵蚀了它的身体！
它饿极了！
雷霆轰击在它的身上！
虚空吞噬了它！
